paraphrase: Haṭha is of two kinds: one practised by Gorakṣa and others, the other by the son of Mṛkaṇḍu and others.
notes: Topic-level locator: exact chapter/verse not recalled (to be supplied in Phase D). Low-confidence recollection from J. Birch's article on the meaning of haṭha; the second kind is usually taken as the eight-limbed (Yājñavalkya/DYŚ-type) haṭha.
